name: Variance-Adaptive Multi-Resolution Grid
definition: A variance-adaptive multi-resolution grid method supporting RGB-D and point cloud inputs, using variance-driven voxel allocation to retain high resolution in complex areas and coarser voxels in flat regions.
summary: The Variance-Adaptive Multi-Resolution Grid is a sparse voxel method that dynamically adjusts resolution based on temporal variance, using a flat hash table to efficiently merge low-variance blocks for memory savings.
